instruction: Extract a screenshot at exactly 3 seconds from the video 'src.mp4' on the desktop and save it as 'screenshot_3s.jpg'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting frame at exactly 3 seconds and saving as JPEG. Evaluator checks file exists, is JPEG format, and verifies the image content matches the actual frame at 3s from src.mp4 using SSIM image similarity.
metadata.verification: Verified JPEG format check using PIL Image.format and temporal frame verification using OpenCV to extract frame at 3s and SSIM for image similarity comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage - all 4 requirements fully verified: (1) File exists at /home/user/Desktop/screenshot_3s.jpg, (2) File is in JPEG format via PIL Image.format check, (3) Screenshot extracted at exactly 3 seconds verified via SSIM comparison with reference frame extracted at timestamp=3.0 from src.mp4, (4) From correct source video src.mp4

Correct temporal verification logic - expected.rules.reference_frame calls get_video_frame_at_timestamp__8d385ddc with timestamp=3.0, which uses OpenCV to extract the actual frame at exactly 3 seconds from the source video

Robust content verification - metric uses SSIM (Structural Similarity Index) to compare user's screenshot with reference frame, threshold=0.85 ensures high similarity, prevents trivial bypass by requiring actual frame content match
Proper data flow - result getter fetches user-created file, expected getter extracts reference frame at 3s, metric compares both using image similarity, returns 1.0 only if all checks pass
Edge case handling - metric correctly handles None/empty results, missing files, format mismatches, and comparison errors with appropriate logging
